scope: frozen saved K5 originals only; no solver/evaluator

definitions.eligible: original ops excluding COPY_IN and COPY_OUT; contracted precedence from DAGIndex
definitions.chain: maximal directed path whose internal edges have outdegree/in-degree one
definitions.work: sum max(1, original cycles) by original pipe; excludes prepared COPY and spill
definitions.balanced_compute_lb: max over original pipes of ceil(total original pipe work/5); hypothetical only
definitions.residual: Makespan minus maximum per-core original pipe work; descriptive, not waiting attribution
definitions.cross_tensor: physical tensor with original producer and consumer on differing cores
